name: PHP Version Manager (Tauri + Rust + React)
description: Cross-platform desktop app to install, switch, and remove PHP runtimes: checksum-verified downloads, safe filesystem updates, and a Rust core behind a React UI.
longDescription: A developer tool for managing multiple PHP versions on one machine. A Tauri shell hosts a React interface for browsing releases, downloading verified builds, activating a version, and cleaning the cache. Rust handles filesystem changes with rollback support so failed installs do not leave the system in a broken state. Automated builds and tests validate packaging metadata and platform prerequisites before release.
features: Install, activate, and remove PHP versions with clear UI feedback
Checksum verification before activating downloaded runtimes
Atomic filesystem operations with rollback on failure
Cache management and progress reporting for long downloads
Cross-platform support focused on Windows and Linux
Automated build and test pipeline for releases
highlights: Memory-safe install engine separated from the UI layer
Supply-chain aware downloads with integrity checks
challenges: PATH and filesystem changes can break developer environments if applied incorrectly.
solutions: Verified downloads, atomic updates with rollback, and explicit user consent before system-wide changes.
security: Verify checksums from official sources before install
Avoid elevated privileges unless strictly required
No secrets stored in local settings
Clear UX when modifying user PATH variables
